apiKeys.intro: Use these credentials (client ID + secret) to authenticate your API calls. The secret is shown only once when generated — store it securely.

cert.intro: Encrypt the verification PII (national number + biometrics) to this certificate before sending — JWE with RSA-OAEP-256 + A256GCM. Put the key id below in the JWE 'kid' header.
cert.rotateConfirm: Rotate the encryption key? Clients must switch to the new certificate; the old one keeps working only for in-flight requests.
